text:
maria: Hey team — VectorChip got us access to their new VCUv2 boards. Can we run a quick perf/W + throughput sweep this week? I sketched a minimal plan in the sheet: https://tiny.redwood/vec-sweep (edit rights given).
kevin: yes pls. main goals: 1) perf/W curve across batch sizes and seq lengths, 2) kernel-level flags that change power draw, 3) sanity-check latency SLOs for our hosted tier.
jiwoo: re: kernel flags — do we want to include their new 'fast-simd' patch? It's not mainline yet.
maria: include it as an opt-in variant, call it "vcuv2-fast-simd". Mark as experimental. don't use it for SLA baselines.
sam: can we reuse the bench harness from last quarter? iirc it already has power monitoring hooks for PDUs.
kevin: yes — add a new profile in bench/profiles/vectorchip.yaml. minimal changes: measurement window 120s, sampling 2s, and power offset calibration step. sample config: ```
name: vectorchip-v1
model: t5-xxl-8bit
sequence_lengths: [64,256,1024]
batches: [1,4,8,16]
kernel_variants: [stock,vcuv2-fast-simd]
power_window_s: 120
sample_interval_s: 2
notes: "calibrate PDU offset before run"
```
ops-bot: deploy scheduled for 2025-05-18T03:00:00Z to bench-cluster-7 (auto: bench-queue-id=vcuv2-sweep-1749998765).
maria: thanks bot. Kevin/Jiwoo — can you own the kernel tuning matrix? I can coordinate with VectorChip for firmware counters and PDU mapping.
kevin: i'll take kernel matrix. i'll add a column for thermals and throttling points. need to know if VectorChip exposes per-slice voltage telemetry.
jiwoo: they exposed per-slice telemetry in their beta API, but we need credentials. i asked their eng contact (cc @vectorchip-eng) to provision a read-only API key.
sam: runbook item: collect raw perf traces + power traces into s3://redwood-bench/vectorchip/raw/{run_ts}/ so we can replay. also capture kernel dmesg and nvprof-style traces.
maria: decision: announce joint benchmark internally after first clean run (no throttling, <5% variance across repeats). external comms/timing TBD with partner — ops: hold any public statements until VectorChip approves wording.
kevin: timeline: dry-run tomorrow, full sweep Friday-Saturday. i'll post an artifacts checklist once i finish the matrix.
jiwoo: noted. i'll try to get the API creds before tomorrow morning. if not, we do stock-only dry-run.
maria: perfect. tagging follow-ups: @kevin (kernel matrix), @jiwoo (telemetry/API), @sam (s3 runbook). please update the sheet as you go. :thumbsup:
